podcast.title: Japanese Beer Commercial
podcast.body: Harrison Ford reportedly agreed to do a beer commercial in Japan, likely believing that it would not be widely seen or known in the Western world. "Harrison Ford did a beer commercial this way."

podcast.title: Roadie for The Doors
podcast.body: Before his career in acting took off, Harrison Ford worked as a roadie for the renowned rock band The Doors, humping gear for them. "Would you believe that Harrison Ford worked as a Rody for the doors before he got into acting?"
